blocks.title: things every coach has done to *keep up* with their DMs

list: you DM'd 40 people by hand after one good post. your thumbs still hate you.
you paid a friend $50 a month to answer your DMs. that friend now knows way too much.
you sent voice notes to sound more human. then you heard your own voice, ugh.
you kept a notes app full of replies to copy and paste. the title is in caps.
you answered "how much?" from the couch at 11:47 pm, in your pajamas.
you followed up once, then felt too d\*mn desperate to do it again.

blocks.caption: be honest, which number is you?

blocks.title: none of this is a *character flaw*

blocks.text: it's what happens when a post works and **one person has to answer everyone.** the leads are real. so is your bedtime.

it's called ManySetter, an AI setter for Manychat. you keep your flows: they still send the first message. when the lead replies, the setter takes over, asks one question at a time, and only sends your calendar to the right people.

your friend gets their evenings back.

tell me in the comments, no judgment here. if it's all six, you get a virtual hug and a setter.

**build your setter free, no card to start, link in bio.**
